controls.name: identity microphone passthrough
controls.role: Paired baseline with no cancellation; required to expose near-end damage and peak behavior.

controls.name: fixed attenuation
controls.role: Non-adaptive attenuation control separated from adaptive-reference metrics.

controls.name: no-reference passthrough
controls.role: Withheld render must pass through without adaptation or weight change; no-reference is not reference AEC.

controls.name: delayed and misaligned render
controls.role: Checks explicit reference alignment and rejects silent trimming; measured fixture lag is not device latency.

controls.name: far-end-only valid window for ERLE
controls.role: ERLE is reported only on sufficiently quiet far-end-only windows, not during double talk.

controls.name: double-talk near-end reference preservation
controls.role: Separate near-end preservation metric; echo attenuation alone cannot pass a duplex claim.

controls.name: path-change and reset schedule
controls.role: Abrupt echo-path change and reset behavior are frozen; reconvergence is reported separately.

controls.name: optional residual postfilter OFF
controls.role: SpeexDSP residual suppression is compared against MDF alone and stays OFF when near-end preservation is not recovered.

controls.name: predicted versus human score separation
controls.role: AECMOS echo/degradation predictions are labelled as predicted and never relabelled as human ratings.
